com.sun.xml.internal.ws.policy

类 EffectiveAlternativeSelector

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.sun.xml.internal.ws.policy.EffectiveAlternativeSelector
  • 直接已知子类:
    AlternativeSelector

    public class EffectiveAlternativeSelector
extends Object
    Contains static methods for policy alternative selection. Given policy map is changed so that each effective policy contains at most one policy alternative. Uses domain specific @see com.sun.xml.internal.ws.policy.spi.PolicySelector to find out whether particular policy assertion is actually supported. If you are using JAX-WS, use the com.sun.xml.internal.ws.api.policy.AlternativeSelector instead of this class.
    作者:
    Jakub Podlesak (jakub.podlesak at sun.com), Fabian Ritzmann

      • doSelection

        public static void doSelection(EffectivePolicyModifier modifier)
                        throws PolicyException
        Does the selection for policy map bound to given modifier. If you are using JAX-WS, use the com.sun.xml.internal.ws.api.policy.AlternativeSelector instead of this class.
        参数:
        modifier - Holds the policy map
        抛出:
        PolicyException - Most likely an internal error if a policy could not be read or set on the policy map
        另请参阅:
        which the map is bound to
